Flexaudio microphone capture adapter
Source: https://github.com/Studio-Sadola/flexaudio
Revision: e36ca9fe8151cd821a35a13aa8fbf55c999e64ce
Original package version: 0.3.0
Author: tubome / Studio Sadola and Flexaudio contributors
License: MIT, reproduced in LICENSE

Lince adaptations: CPAL 0.18 device descriptions, plain sample rates,
by-value stream configuration, unified error API and shared sample conversion
for the PCM formats supported by CPAL, including 24-bit and double precision.
Known device buffer ranges use a bounded 512-frame request.
The remaining Flexaudio
crates retain their upstream git revision. Source comments are omitted to
follow the host repository's source convention. The original capture thread,
startup transient guard and tests are retained.
